regime_context: Memory, HBM & Storage leads with strong momentum and eligibility but mixed durability. Broad participation (72% eligible) and no one-narrative extreme suggest a diverse opportunity set. Crowding flags on Cybersecurity and Managed Care warrant caution. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped control drawdowns in US equities.
emerging_watch: Cybersecurity: currently rank-2 with high trend (durability 0.89) but elevated crowding. Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff. Kill-condition: if Cybersecurity score fails to surpass 3.0 and Memory/HBM remains >3.0 within the next 15 trading days, the handoff hypothesis is negated.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM tops the momentum focus list and remains above the absolute-trend gate, offering risk-controlled exposure. Low crowding and a wide gap to the challenger support a modest overweight. Durability is only mixed, so conviction is low; this is a focus lens, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Mixed durability and zero breadth suggest leadership driven by a narrow set of stocks; the theme could reverse quickly and the gate may not fully protect if momentum collapses.

falsifier.text: Memory score falls below 2.0 and Cybersecurity overtakes as rank-1 theme, or SMH closes below its 50-day moving average on a weekly basis.

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: Strong trend (durability 0.81) and high breadth (0.89) are offset by a crowded positioning reading (z=1.77). Crowding flags a size-down caution; initiating new long exposure carries elevated risk of choppy or mean-reverting price action.
theses.dissent: The underlying trend could remain so powerful that the breadth overcomes crowding, and the gate may still limit drawdowns; avoiding it could mean missing a durable up-move.

falsifier.text: XLV breaks to new 20-day highs with expanding advance-decline line and crowding z-score retracts below 1.0, or Managed Care improves to top-3 rank.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
